title: The Effect of Self-Regulated Learning Strategies on Learners Perception of Personal Learning Responsibility

abstracts.value:
This study is to investigate the effect of self-regulated learning strategies on learners personal responsibility (learning orientation and learning attribution).
A learning material was developed to encourage learners to self-regulate their learning processes in self-paced learning environments. Self-assessment was employed to measure and analyze their learning responsibility.
As a result, it was found that self-regulated learning strategies affected learners personal responsibility.
